description: Walks backwards from the failed action and builds a chronological chain of preceding actions, network errors, and console errors. Surfaces the most likely root cause.

lookback_ms.description: How far back from the failure to look, in milliseconds (default 5000)

trace_path.description: Absolute path to trace.zip, or a URL (https://) to download it from

name: get_causal_chain_for_failure
